titulo: One pebble at a time: the water rises
caption:
One pebble at a time: the water rises

A jar with a little water. Cella drops one pebble, waits, then drops the next one. The water comes up a bit each time.

For whoever drops the next one.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with a voice on a flat color background in a room with a window. At the top, the words: 1 pebble at a time. For whoever drops one pebble and waits. A small doorway-shaped figure with white eyes stands to the left, a pile of three gray pebbles on the floor in the middle and a tall glass jar with a little water and two pebbles at the bottom on the right. The words appear one line at a time: one pebble. I drop it (a pebble arcs into the jar, a ripple spreads and the water rises a little). I wait (a speech bubble with three dots). Then the next one (a second pebble drops in, the water rises again, a star appears and her eyes close in a smile). The closing line: for whoever drops the next one. Then: Choose friction.
comentario_fijado: Cella dropped one pebble and waited. Somebody keeps dropping them too.
evolucion: Tres apuestas (junta-ene-s2, seccion 3). (a) El cierre con persona, sin pedido: ninguna pieza pide guardar, comentar, compartir, enviar ni seguir (regla 8); el fijado es una frase de Cella que nombra al destinatario. Base de lectura: N2 16 % (14 de 88 Reels), 1,5 envios por 1.000 de alcance, mediana de alcance 117; con el mismo corte de la hora 168. (b) El destinatario como gancho: brazo A (abre con "For whoever ..." en el cuadro 0 y vuelve a cerrar) contra brazo B (solo cierra). Se mide a 48 h con medir.py (envios por 1.000 de alcance, vistas comprometidas) y a 7 dias con objetivos.py (N2, N4). Con 17 seguidores no separa causa de ruido: lectura de orden de magnitud. Hora (apuesta 3a): los Shorts de las 23:00Z contra los de 17:00Z de la misma semana.
